Martinez G.M. et al. (2017) The modern near-surface Martian climate: a review of in-situ meteorological data from Viking to Curiosity, Space Science Reviews 212:295-338, DOI:10.1007/s11214-017-0360-x (journal full text checked 19/11/2026), Fig. 3 top p.308: daily mean surface pressure, read from the figure (grid 50 Pa, reading uncertainty about +/- 10 Pa). MSL (Curiosity, Gale), Mars years 31-33: seasonal minimum about 735 Pa (Ls ~150 deg) and maximum about 925 Pa (Ls ~250 deg); value = middle of the seasonal range. Consistent with the ideal gas law for CO2 with the air density and temperature of the matrix (about 780 Pa)
